data.task-lists#Task lists (GFM dialect):
Task lists (- [x] done, - [ ] todo) are not part of kramdown’s own syntax: the reference gem, and go-kramdown by default, print [x] literally. Select the GFM dialect (kramdown-parser-gfm) to render checkboxes, byte-identical to the gem:
o := kramdown.DefaultOptions() o.Input = "GFM" html := kramdown.ToHTML("- [x] done\n- [ ] todo\n", &o)
